o.en: When listing the differences, only list those that are asked for. The list itself is a comma-separated list of desired difference types. Recognized types are: masked Show masked files equivalent Show overridden files that while overridden, do not differ in content. redirected Show files that are redirected to another.
When showing modified files, when a file is overridden show a diff as well. This option takes a boolean argument. If omitted, it defaults to true.
Print a short help text and exit.
Print a short version string and exit.
Do not pipe output into a pager.
